acceptance.absolute_utility: Upper multiplicity-adjusted 95% bound on latent MAE is at most 0.02 line lengths in every primary cell in both A and B.
acceptance.added_mechanism_promotion: A refinement is promoted only with a preregistered practical gain over the unchanged incumbent, adjusted evidence of positive gain, and all applicable stability and retention checks passing.
acceptance.baseline_competitiveness: In every primary cell and both batches, the upper adjusted bound on MAE_online - 1.10 * MAE_primary_baseline is at most 0.00001.
acceptance.evidence_integrity: All expected artifacts, strict mandatory checks, primitive evidence, hashes, and independent arithmetic must be present and passing.
acceptance.moderate_noise_adaptation: For every primary changed-law stationary cell, the multiplicity-adjusted lower confidence bound on the relative reduction in online cumulative first-50-transition error versus its frozen clone is strictly greater than 10% in both A and B.
acceptance.numerical_stability: No registered cell may have an unhandled exception, nonfinite forecast/state, silent sample loss, or unrecorded reset.
acceptance.reference_preservation: The v2.1 raw and resolved identities remain unchanged and zero-noise behavioral equivalence passes within the declared tolerance.
acceptance.unchanged_law_retention: The same adjusted noninferiority rule is applied against the matched frozen learner in every primary unchanged-law cell.

absolute_utility.adjustment: Holm once across the joint A+B primary family

baseline_competitiveness.adjustment: Holm once across the joint A+B primary family

moderate_noise_adaptation.adjustment: Holm once across the joint A+B primary family

unchanged_law_retention.adjustment: Holm once across the joint A+B primary family

added_mechanism_promotion.adjustment: Holm once across the joint A+B primary family

artifacts.durable_storage_policy: The full archive must be copied to repository-approved durable storage and its immutable locator recorded before any independent-reproduction claim; a transient CI artifact is insufficient.
artifacts.raw_record_encoding: newline-delimited JSON with deterministic UTF-8 encoding in deterministic per-trial gzip shards, ordered by trial_id then step through records/index.json; the concatenated uncompressed byte stream and every compressed shard are hashed

baselines.alpha_beta_filter: Causal fixed-parameter alpha-beta state estimator with settings selected only on development data; state updates are not parameter learning.
baselines.causal_smoothing_motion: Causal moving-average smoothing followed by constant-motion extrapolation, with the same observation history and boundary policy.
baselines.constant_motion: Raw constant-motion extrapolation from the last two predictor-visible observations.
baselines.constant_motion_reflected: Constant-motion extrapolation plus the identical public latent-boundary reflection map.
baselines.incumbent_square_root_rls: Unchanged v2.1 square-root RLS configuration, trained under the declared condition.
baselines.no_learning_control: Zero-initialized incumbent architecture with updates disabled after initialization.
baselines.primary_deployable_baseline: constant_motion_reflected is selected before confirmation from development data; it is a fair physical-boundary comparator, while incumbent_square_root_rls is the model-development comparator.

compute_storage.estimate: Development smoke is CPU-only and bounded; the full plan is 10 lineages x 32 episodes x 3 sensor realizations across registered cells plus matched branches. The run manifest records exact elapsed time and bytes.
compute_storage.platform: CPU-only, headless, repository-supported Python 3.10 through 3.13 matrix.
compute_storage.raw_record_encoding: Primitive records retain latent truth, raw observation, predictor-visible history, forecasts, targets, update decisions, and diagnostics; schedules are stored separately.
compute_storage.retention: Retain failed, cancelled, superseded, compact, and full archives with immutable attempt IDs; never overwrite an attempt directory.

endpoints.adaptation: Cumulative normalized latent absolute error over the first 50 transitions after a declared physical-law intervention, including the first surprise, compared with a full-state frozen clone.
endpoints.intervals: Causal 90% and 95% observation-prediction intervals from past noisy residuals, with coverage, width, and interval score by channel, level, and regime.
endpoints.primary: Latent next-position MAE divided by line length, with paired hierarchical uncertainty and fixed balanced cell weighting.
endpoints.secondary: RMSE, signed bias, p95/p99 absolute error, noisy-observation target error, update norms, detector activity, skips, resets, memory, and latency.
endpoints.stress: Highest Gaussian level, correlated noise, impulsive noise, sensor shifts, and factorial law/noise branches are reported separately and are not promoted after observation.

bouncing.description: Existing moving-dot reflection family with stationary observation noise; both walls remain visible in evaluator truth.

changed_law.description: Existing damped-oscillator family with a fixed law intervention after a 300-step common prefix and a 100-step branch.

constant_velocity.description: Existing straight-motion family evaluated over the full 32 direction-position-speed strata.

speed_change.description: Existing constant-velocity family with an unannounced speed-magnitude change at transition 300 and a 100-step post-event branch.

hypotheses.h0: Observation noise degrades next-position prediction and can trigger the incumbent's surprise response without a physical-law change.
hypotheses.h1: At the two lower primary levels, a fixed causal refinement can reduce latent forecast error under matched information and resources.
hypotheses.h2: A noise-level shift is distinguishable from a changed physical law only through predeclared controls, not by treating detector activity as a successful law-change detection.
hypotheses.mechanism_policy: No refinement is presumed effective; each substantive mechanism must be justified by a development failure mechanism, budgeted, and tested with removal ablations.

gaussian.definition: eta_t = s z_t with independent standard-normal z_t

impulsive.definition: eta_t = s(z_t + 10 b_t r_t)/sqrt(2), b_t~Bernoulli(0.01), r_t in {-1,+1}
impulsive.variance: approximately s^2 by the declared construction

schedules.correlated_shift_rule: For a shifted correlated channel, generate one stationary unit-variance AR(1) innovation path and multiply each timestamp by its predeclared time-varying scale.
schedules.floating_point_encoding: IEEE-754 binary64 values serialized with deterministic JSON number encoding; actual arrays are hashed before execution.
schedules.generator: numpy.random.Generator with PCG64 and numpy.random.SeedSequence stream derivation
schedules.pairing: Common random numbers pair predictors within a cell; A and B use disjoint latent and sensor namespaces; branches share latent paths and sensor schedules.
schedules.stream_derivation: SeedSequence([root_seed, namespace, channel, scale_microunits, family, lineage, episode, realization]) with stable UTF-8 labels converted to uint32 words.

search_budget.confirmation_freeze: Commit selected candidate, baselines, schedules, analysis code, full run plan, and environment identity before reading either A or B.
search_budget.design_freeze: Commit this protocol, generator, development/confirmation separation, and candidate-search budget before comparing candidate variants.

statistics.multiplicity_family: Holm correction across all primary endpoint x cell x batch claims; adjusted confidence bounds are reported.
statistics.null_validation: Known-null and false-positive simulations are separate from benchmark draws and validate finite-sample interval behavior before confirmation.
statistics.undefined_ratio_rule: If the baseline denominator is zero or missing, report the relative ratio as undefined and do not replace it with zero or PASS.

title: AAA observation_noise_v1.1 - controlled next-position prediction under observation noise

training.calibration_allocation: A fixed calibration prefix is drawn only from the declared training mixture; no clean target or evaluation-channel parameter is visible to a predictor.
training.calibration_policy: Causal residual quantile calibration from past noisy residuals only; calibration adaptation is reported separately from point-predictor adaptation.
training.freeze_parameters_vs_filter_state: Frozen arms retain ordinary observation history and fixed-parameter filter state; only learned parameters and adaptive predictor state are frozen. The complete pre-intervention state is cloned and tested.
